title: Bedrock Titan completions: top_p=0 is rejected with a 422 before any upstream call, because Titan requires topP strictly greater than 0
answers: Why does a Bedrock Titan completion return a 422 when top_p is 0?
Why is top_p zero rejected for amazon titan models through the gateway?
Where is top_p validated for Bedrock Titan completions?
body:
Path: Titan completion requests (llm/v1/completions routed to amazon.titan models) pass through AWSTitanAdapter.completions_to_model in mlflow/gateway/providers/bedrock.py, which validates n and top_p, halves temperature, and builds the textGenerationConfig.
Rule: AWSTitanAdapter.completions_to_model raises AIGatewayException with status_code=422 when top_p == 0, because MLflow accepts 0 but Titan requires topP > 0. The check runs before the request reaches AmazonBedrockProvider._request, so no call is made to Bedrock.
Symptom: Without the guard, top_p=0 would be forwarded to Titan, which the adapter comment says requires a value strictly greater than 0.
Constraints: Applies only to Titan; the AI21 adapter has no equivalent check. Only exactly 0 is rejected; negative or out-of-range values are not validated here. An absent top_p is unaffected because the check uses payload.get.
applies: Bedrock Titan completions adapter validation in mlflow/gateway/providers/bedrock.py; not AI21 or other providers.
says: Submitting a Titan completion with nucleus sampling set to zero returns a validation error.
Why does setting the sampling threshold to zero fail on Amazon Titan completions?
Setting the sampling parameter to zero triggers a 422 error on Titan models.
Titan completions should accept zero for nucleus sampling without immediately rejecting the request.
search: In mlflow/gateway/providers/bedrock.py, AWSTitanAdapter.completions_to_model validates Titan completion requests and raises an AIGatewayException with status_code=422 when top_p equals 0, preventing upstream calls to AmazonBedrockProvider._request because Titan requires topP strictly greater than 0. This validation applies exclusively to Titan models and does not check AI21 models or negative and out-of-range values. The check is tested in tests/gateway/providers/test_bedrock.py:test_bedrock_titan_rejects_top_p_zero.
